newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 2.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Four Palestinians killed in protests against Israel.
- U.S. President Clinton meets Jordan's King Hussein in Washington.
- Saudi cabinet agrees to change status of the National Commercial Bank to a joint stock company.
- Emirates Airline borrows $118 million to finance the purchase of a fourth Boeing 777.
- Oman rejects an Israeli request to participate in a communications exhibition in Muscat.
- Egyptian businessmen agree with German and U.S. firms to build a cement plant in Cairo.
